'''Aril Kyak''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] who was the wife of [[Syub Kyak]] and the mother of [[Fiev Kyak]] and [[Sien Kyak]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], she and her family traveled to the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] for a vacation and hired the space [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] ''[[Crest of Dawn]]'' from [[Cularin Star Tours]] to travel around the system in. However, her children rewired some of the ship's controls and it became stuck in a radiation storm on [[Genarius]]. The CST safety ship ''[[Starchaser IV]]'' arrived and managed the save Aril and the rest of her family.
